user.title: TCP gateway
user.description: Enter the gateway host and port. After TCP validation, choose a search range; scanning does not start automatically.

setup_devices.description: Choose whether this gateway has pollable Modbus devices or S402 scene inputs.

add_s402.description: Enter the S402's local ID (0–255). It is separate from Modbus Slave IDs.

reconfigure.title: Change TCP gateway
reconfigure.description: Settings are saved only after the new TCP connection succeeds. Device and entity identities are retained.
